player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a {max_rounds} round game of Kuhn Poker.
Game Rules:
- Kuhn Poker uses a 3-card deck with J, Q, K (J lowest, K highest)
- Each player antes {ante} chip and receives 1 card each round (note that the cards are dealt without replacement, so you cannot have the same card as your opponent).
- Game continues for {max_rounds} rounds
- The player with the most chips after all rounds wins
Action Rules:
- '[check]': Pass without betting (only if no bet is on the table)
- '[bet]': Add 1 chip to the pot (only if no bet is on the table)
- '[call]': Match an opponent's bet by adding 1 chip to the pot
- '[fold]': Surrender your hand and let your opponent win the pot

init_round.round_start: ### መጀመሪያ ምዕራፍ {current_round} ካብ {max_rounds} ምዕራፍ. ካርድካ ኣብዚ: '{player_card}'

showdown.showdown_summary: Showdown: Player {winner}'s {winner_card} beats Player {loser}'s {loser_card}. Player {winner} wins pot of {pot_value} chips.
